title: Detlev Bronk rumored to be on Majestic 12

tellings.quote: Detlev Bronk was the president of the Rockefeller Foundation. He was rumored to be the Yeah, president. He was rumored to be on the Majestic 12, rumored to do all the early alien autopsies

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a scientist named Detlev Bronk, whom he describes as president of the Rockefeller Foundation, was rumored to sit on Majestic 12, a supposed secret US panel of the late 1940s said to handle crashed flying saucers. Michels adds that Bronk was also rumored to have done the early autopsies on alien bodies, which, if true, would put a top American scientist at the heart of a hidden alien recovery effort.
